title: Importing SQL Code | Using SQL | InterSystems IRIS Data Platform 2026.1

examples.sql: CREATE TABLE Sample.MyStudents (StudentName VARCHAR(32),StudentDOB DATE) GO CREATE INDEX NameIdx ON TABLE Sample.MyStudents (StudentName) GO INSERT INTO Sample.MyStudents (StudentName,StudentDOB) SELECT Name, DOB FROM Sample.Person WHERE Age <= '21' GO INSERT INTO Sample.MyStudents (StudentName,StudentDOB) VALUES ('Jones,Mary',60123) GO UPDATE Sample.MyStudents SET StudentName='Smith-Jones,Mary' WHERE StudentName='Jones,Mary' GO DELETE FROM Sample.MyStudents WHERE StudentName %STARTSWITH 'A' GO
